name: LLMHound P4: anonymous AI services with an execution surface
description: Services that answered anonymous enumeration and expose a declared or inferred execution surface. exec_surface_basis says how; nothing was executed.
query:
MATCH (s:LLMHound_AIService)-[:LLMHound_ObservedAt]->(h)
WHERE NOT h:LLMHound_NetworkEndpoint
  AND s.auth_observed IN ['anonymous', 'mixed']
  AND any(x IN s.exec_surface WHERE x IN ['code_kernel','terminal','job_submit','code_eval','workflow_exec','tool_invocation'])
RETURN s, h
LIMIT 100
